history.headline: Six days out from the crossing, the taper has landed clean. Legs are banked, engine intact, movement holding through the logistics window. The next chapter is written on the trail, not here.
watch_items: Watch whether recovery nights steady in the final days before departure — this is the one metric that's stayed variable and the one that compounds most under a multi-day self-supported load.
Once the crossing begins, track how easy-run HR responds to daily pack-loaded efforts stacking up — the first two or three days will redefine what "easy" actually costs.
Note the back-to-back leg response over the opening stretch; early durability under cumulative load is the genuine unknown, not the underlying fitness.
Keep an eye on whether movement holds through the final travel window as a read on residual freshness into the transition.

history.headline: Five days to the crossing. The taper has held clean and the final travel window is here. Everything from now is logistics — the trail writes the rest.
watch_items: Watch whether recovery nights finally steady through the travel-and-transition days — it's been the one persistently variable thread and the one that compounds most once daily pack-loaded efforts stack up.
Over the opening stretch, note how "easy" HR responds as consecutive loaded days accumulate — the first few days will redefine what easy actually costs.
Track the back-to-back leg response early; cumulative durability under a 6-8kg pack is the genuine unknown, not the underlying engine.
Once the trail begins, watch how the mountain-crossing section sits within the daily rhythm — the border climb is the one terrain spike worth reading separately from the flatter days.

history.headline: Four days out and the final quiet holds. Strength stayed live right up to the edge, legs are fresh, engine banked. Everything from here is the trail itself.
